gaps.title: Extra fights cannot buy safety
gaps.detail: Over-level EXP is cut to 0.2x and the cap is 30, so fighting three times as many battles puts a child only about one level ahead at each boss, and an Attack-only child hits the cap with nowhere to grow. Raise the over-level floor to about 0.6 and the cap to 40 (extend EXP_TABLE and growth anchors) so grinding always helps.

events.note: P19-overlevel ok=true; battle.test 40/40; keel wayOver=0.6; cap=40 hp40=468

gaps.title: Seeds have no permanent stat hook
gaps.detail: P30 drops a Seed of Life in the hollow of the fallen oak in the meadow. It is eaten on the spot: treasure.js records it in its own ledger and writes member.seedHp += 3 on the party leader, plus +3 to current HP. But src/data/growth.js statsFor(member, L) recomputes hp purely from the level curve, so the moment Roster.heal() or a level-up runs, the seed bonus vanishes. Fix in growth.js: have statsFor() add member.seedHp / member.seedMp / member.seedMight etc (a small {stat: bonus} bag on the member) on top of the personality curve, and expose a helper addSeed(member, stat, n). P30 already writes and saves member.seedHp, so nothing else has to change. Verify: __DQ.treasure().seeds shows {life:1} and the leader's max HP stays 3 higher after __DQ.heal().

events.note: statsFor() adds seedBonus(member) from member.seed / member.seedHp. addSeed() helper for menu Use. Measured shots/P21-P19-seed3: before 20 mid 24 after heal 24; seed.hp=4.
